title: Document a module's API in a README
prompt: Write README.md for the module in stats.js. It needs a section for every function stats.js exports, each with a heading of the form '### name(params)' using the function's real parameter names, one sentence on what it returns (including what it does for an empty array), and a fenced js example that calls it. Do not change stats.js or check-readme.js.
